entries.description: Two lesbian lovers who have lived rurally 10 years on 5 acres of desert land. They grow their own food and keep milk-goats, chickens, bees and fruit trees. Welcome visits from lesbians who appreciate rural life and physical work and who are working against racism, classism, ageism and anti-Semitism. Welcome girl children.
entries.raw_text: ARLENE & ARLINE PO Box 511, Desert Hot Springs, CA 92240 (619)329-8916. We are lovers who have lived rurally for the past 10 years. We grow our own food, have milk-goats, chickens, bees, and fruit trees. We live simply and happily, without TV and media, in beautiful desert country with big skies filled with stars. We enjoy visits from lesbians who have an appreciation of rural life and physical work, who are making an effort to eradicate their racist, classist, ageist, anti-Semitic conditioning. We are ethnic women. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 5 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, desert land with much vegetation and trees, women working the land.
entries.notes: Type: two women (a couple, '2 lesbians'), so Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule. Land state CA inferred from the mailing state; PO box so no land street/city/zip. Setting phrase: 'in beautiful desert country with big skies filled with stars'. Residents: 2 from '2 lesbians' and 'We are lovers who have lived rurally'. Accepted: Lesbian women (visits from lesbians); Girl children named. Focus Farming/self-sufficiency from 'We grow our own food, have milk-goats, chickens, bees, and fruit trees'. Women of color: 'We are ethnic women' is an identity of the residents, and the anti-racism statement is inclusiveness; coded as Women of color on the basis of the residents' identity (judgment call).

entries.description: Two lesbians on a ranch where they raise and sell bees and honey, provide pollination services, make beekeeping equipment, and breed horses, donkeys and poultry. They sell mail order items with women's designs. Welcome correspondence from other ranching women; no visitor facilities at present.
entries.raw_text: BEE SONG HONEY FARMS Rt 1 Box 174, Montague, CA 96064. Raise and sell bees and honey, provide pollination services, make and sell beekeeping equipment. Also breed, raise and train Bashkir Curly horses and standardbred donkeys, plus breed and raise a wide variety of poultry, waterfowl and exotics, including peafowl, rare pheasants and emus. Make and sell mail order t-shirts, caps and rubber stamps relating to bees, donkeys, mules, etc, as well as a line of women's designs. Welcome correspondence from other ranching women; no visitor facilities at present. We have/are: 2 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: '2 lesbians' so Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule. Rural route address, so copied to land_*. entries.description: Inactive group with 23 rural, private acres and primitive cabins on the central Oregon coast. One lesbian lives there. Offers work trades for space sharing; welcomes new members/residents, girl and boy children under control, and dogs under control. Hopes to revive the group.
entries.raw_text: PENTHESILEIA c/o CK, PO Box 44, Seal Rock, OR 97376 (503)563-3643. Inactive group with 23 acres plus some primitive cabins. Many skills to share. Very rural, very private, many camping spaces, and trees. Appreciate work trades for space sharing. Come share and experience the mild central Oregon coast climate, help realize your dreams and mine. Call Carol before 5 am or between 5-8:30 pm. Bon Voyage. I welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children under control, dogs under 100% control. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 23 acres, housing/permanent structure, electricity, lots of camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land, inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Type: one woman ('I have/am: 1 lesbian') on the land, an 'inactive group', so Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule. Contact name CK from c/o. entries.description: Open Women's Land in Days Creek, OR dedicated to giving women access to land, especially women who would otherwise be denied. Funded by contributions, publishes a quarterly newsletter with a mailing list of 250. Looking for women to live and work on the land and raising funds to pay off the mortgage under threat of foreclosure. 150 acres.
entries.raw_text: OREGON WOMEN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 1692, Roseburg, OR 97470 (Located in Days Creek, OR ). OWLT is open Women's Land dedicated to provide women access to land, especially those women who would otherwise be denied. We are funded by contributions from women around the country. We have a newsletter that is sent quarterly, with an active mailing list of 250 women. At present, we are looking for women to live and work on the land. We are currently raising funds to pay the remaining mortgage, as the former owners (mortgage holders) are threatening us with monthly foreclosure. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children upon agreement, nonlesbian women, dogs. We have: 150 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farmland, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Type: Land Trust from the name and purpose 'dedicated to provide women access to land'. Land city from 'Located in Days Creek, OR'; PO box so no street/zip. Residents blank: 'women living on the land' but no count given. Accepted: new members/residents so Lesbian women; Non-lesbian women named; girl children and boy children 'upon agreement' (condition noted).

entries.description: Six lesbians on 50 acres 13 miles west of Roseburg who live independently but meet to process big decisions. Dedicated to mother nature and goddess identification; preserve the land as wild as possible and plant trees. Welcome girl children, teens and older lesbians.
entries.raw_text: RAINBOW'S END 886 Raven Ln, Roseburg, OR 97470 (503)673-7649 (13 miles west of Roseburg). We relate independently of one another - we come together for processing big decisions. We all love living in the country in the safety of women's land. We are dedicated to mother nature and are into goddess identification. We preserve the land as wild as much as possible. We love trees and plant often to make up for patriarchal cutting. We bless the land and so appreciate her cradling us. Nature is our best reflection. We welcome: girl children, teens and older lesbians. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 50 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: 6 lesbians living on the land who come together for big decisions, so Intentional Community/Cooperative. Street address is a road address; the listing places the land 13 miles west of Roseburg, so mailing address copied to land_*. Residents: 6 from '6 lesbians' with 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted: Lesbian women ('older lesbians'); Girl children named; 'teens' not coded further. Focus Spirituality/ritual from 'goddess identification' and 'We bless the land'; Environmentalism from 'We preserve the land as wild as much as possible... plant often'; Older women from welcoming 'older lesbians'.

entries.description: Two lesbians aged 57 and 60 on 7 acres with strong interests in photography, ecology and alternative technology. Welcome women of all ages for short or long visits, new residents, girl children, boy children for daytime visits only, non-lesbian women, and dogs on leash. No guns, drugs or dope; smoking limited to an outdoor area. $4/day/woman.

entries.description: Feminist collective of 5-8 lesbians living on 23 acres of forested land in southern Oregon, with a main house, several women-built cabins and secluded camping spots. Welcomes girl children, boy children under age 8, and non-lesbian women for one-to-four day visits when space is available, asking $3/day for food and $2-10/day for the land support fund.
entries.raw_text: WOMANSHARE PO Box 681, Grants Pass, OR 97526 (503)862-2807. WomanShare is a feminist collective of 5-8 lesbians living on forested land in southern Oregon. We have a main house and several women-built cabins and secluded camping spots. The main house has electricity, hot water, and shower. We welcome: girl children, boy children under age 8, nonlesbian women. One-to-four day visits when space is available and we ask $3/day for food and $2-10/day for our land support fund. We have/are: 5-8 lesbians, 23 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, outdoor toilet, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
